children: The April Fools 2022 has ended after the 2nd of April 2022 and almost all associated items have been made unobtainable/removed.
This page has been preserved for historical purposes.

was the third April Fools edition that was added to the game on the 31st of March 2022, and was removed from the game on the 2nd of April 2022. It randomized the faces, animations, and the sounds of towers, units and enemies. Additionally, it also changed the
narrator's icons and dialogue. The icon and thumbnail was also changed into a poorly drawn version of the
icon and thumbnail, while the title was changed multiple times.
The faces of towers, units and enemies were changed into one of the faces below:
The faces used were unique on each server. In one server, a default
, and in another it could use the
. The face only changes if the tower, unit or enemy has a face. Otherwise, it will remain faceless.
This effect can be replicated using the

The animations of towers, units, enemies and emotes were changed into any random animation used in the game. The animation could be any animation used in the game. Due to most enemies, units and towers using R6 while emotes use R15, if they used the animation of an emote, it would not work properly. Similarly, emotes would not work properly when they used an animation of an enemy, unit or a tower that does not use R15. The animations were unique on each server.

was affected by the animation change.

The audio of towers, units and enemies were changed into any random audio used in the game. The audio could be any audio used in the game. Towers, units and enemies could use currently unused audio, such as the
ability audio, or audio from exclusive towers, such as the War Machine. Additionally, there were some sounds that were never heard before in the game, added to the game as part of the
. The audio is unique in each server.
While emotes were affected by animation changes, their music did not change. They would play the intended music.
